evidence: empty_void: seg1:mid and seg1:end park a hairline timeline and a small mascot in the top third and leave the entire bottom ~60% of the frame empty dark gradient with a stray teal ellipse; seg2:mid/end repeat it below the arc gauge.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:mid (t=9.98s) and seg1:end (t=13.68s): one thin 1px year axis with tick labels 1970-2024, a small '32.9%' and a small mascot all crammed into the upper third; the lower ~60% of the vertical frame is bare gradient containing only a detached teal shadow ellipse with no mascot standing on it.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The timeline/scrubber scene is composed at a horizontal-video aspect and centred on one axis line, so the 9:16 canvas is never filled; the mascot's ground-shadow is drawn at its own fixed anchor rather than following the mascot up onto the puck, leaving an orphan artifact in the dead space.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Rebuild seg1 to use the full 9:16 frame: scale the year axis to the mid-band and grow a stacked column of era values (1970 5.5 -> 1988 24.7 -> 2024 32.4) filling the lower two-thirds as the puck passes each year, so the rise is physically demonstrated rather than a number floating over a line; parent the mascot's shadow to the mascot so no orphan ellipse remains.
